text:
alice: Kestrel Therapeutics dedicated rollout request.
alice: Customer needs v2.4.1-quant pinned for inference parity with staging. Requesting 03/30 02:00-04:00 UTC window (Sat) to do canary -> ramp.
bob: Resource check: we have capacity in LAX-dedicated cluster but need slice reservation for 2h + 30m canary. I'll reserve now.carol: FYI we need to flush tenant KV cache before traffic switch, otherwise old tokenization can cause cache-miss storms.
elaine: CS confirmed Kestrel ok with the window, they want 5% canary for 30m, metrics ok to be delayed by 5m for infra propagation.
dave: Any billing/commit implications? customer is on a reserved plan but we should record migration in billing notes.
alice: Plan summary: 1) Reserve slice + pre-warm (priming) 2) Deploy v2.4.1-quant to canary slice 5% 3) Monitor latency/p50/p95, error-rate, and request-level correctness checks 4) Ramp to 100% over 30m if no gates tripped 5) Rollback to v2.4.0 if thresholds exceeded.
bob: I'll run a pre-warm priming job against tenant slice. Command I'm going to run:
```
deploybot prime --tenant kestrel --slice 7 --model v2.4.1-quant --concurrency 4 --samples-file s3://redwood-release/kestrel/priming.json
```
carol: Rollback thresholds proposal: error-rate > 1.5% OR p95 latency > 2.5x baseline OR request-failure spike > +200 calls/min for 5m -> immediate rollback.
elaine: Kestrel wants a manual hold at 5%: they want CS to signoff after canary checks before ramp. We should add that to runbook.
dave: Noted, I'll add billing note and customer notification template.
alice: Adding runbook snippet and release notes link: https://confluence.redwood/release/v2.4.1-quant/kestrel
alice: Also pinning runtime: runtime-image: redwood/runtime:2026-03-18-rc3, model-version: v2.4.1-quant, commit: a7f3d9b
bob: Reservation created: slice-7 reserved in LAX for 2026-03-30T02:00Z-04:30Z (includes buffer). deploybot job queued ID 482901.
deploybot: Scheduled priming job 482901 for tenant kestrel, slice 7. ETA 10m.
bob: Priming started. logs: `priming: 120/120 samples processed, avg latency 45ms, token coverage 98%`
carol: Thanks. I'll wire up the synthetic tests against canary endpoints and post the pass/fail from the dashboard.
alice: We need explicit approvals in this thread: CS signoff, infra signoff, SRE signoff, and release-mgr signoff before we flip beyond 5%.
elaine: CS: approved, will do after canary checks. :white_check_mark:
bob: Infra: approved for reservation + priming. :thumbsup:
carol: SRE: approved for canary + monitoring hooks. Will trigger rollback if thresholds tripped. :ok_hand:
dave: Sales: acknowledged, billing note added.
alice: Release-mgr: approved. Good to schedule. I'll kick the handoff doc to oncall and post runbook in #eng-oncall one hour before.
alice: Quick rollback command if needed:
```
deploybot rollback --tenant kestrel --slice 7 --to-model v2.4.0 --force
```
alice: Final question: any objections to scheduled window? please reply with approve/hold within 1h.
bob: approve
carol: approve
elaine: approve
repo-bot: (automated) created release note entry for Kestrel rollout: RN-2026-03-30-ktl
alice: Great — locking window and notify teams. I'll paste the runbook and final schedule to #eng-oncall and CS one hour prior.
